experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Designed, developed and maintained scalable RESTful APIs with Django REST Framework for the core backend of Triboon Panel.
Worked with PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery and RabbitMQ to build reliable, high-performance services.
Implemented backend features, designed database schemas, built admin functionality, and extended Triboon's Telegram bot with new commands and callback-based workflows.
Refactored legacy modules to improve maintainability and code quality.
Primary backend developer for a new advertising platform connecting brands with influencers, media channels and websites; built the core services and APIs from scratch with Django REST Framework.
Worked with Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, AWS S3 and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).

projects.name: L.A. Noire
projects.summary: A noir-style full-stack web application inspired by the Rockstar game L.A. Noire, built as a Web Programming course project. It emphasizes clean architecture and production-ready engineering, with JWT-based authentication, a focus on maintainability, scalability and deployment readiness.

projects.name: Lost&Found
projects.summary: Backend for a location-based web application for reporting and locating lost items on the SUT campus map, built for a Systems Analysis and Design course. RESTful APIs were implemented with Django REST Framework.
projects.notes: The CV names SQLite in the project header and PostgreSQL in the description, so the record does not say which one is used.

projects.name: RabbitMQ
projects.summary: A simplified RabbitMQ-inspired message broker built with Clean Architecture, focusing on modular design, maintainability and separation of concerns.

projects.name: Link-Shortener
projects.summary: A URL shortening service designed with Domain-Driven Design and CQRS to separate reads and writes. An event-driven architecture gives asynchronous communication between loosely coupled components, improving scalability and maintainability.

projects.name: Database Project
projects.summary: Database schema design for a trip reservation system, with an Entity-Relationship Diagram and design documentation. The relational database was implemented in SQL with tables, relationships, constraints and normalization. Queries support booking transportation tickets, reserving hotels and retrieving travel information.

projects.name: Computer Structure and Languages Project
projects.summary: An Assembly application that does arithmetic on arbitrary-precision integers larger than the processor's register size, plus Gaussian elimination in Assembly to solve systems of linear equations. It emphasizes low-level memory management and efficient matrix handling.

projects.name: Mobile Programming Exercises
projects.summary: Several Android applications written in Java and XML for a mobile development course, including a calculator, a Tic-Tac-Toe game and various user interface exercises.

projects.name: Stronghold Crusaders
projects.summary: A strategy game inspired by Stronghold Crusader, with core gameplay mechanics and an interactive graphical interface. It uses the Model-View-Controller pattern for a modular, maintainable and extensible codebase.
